reviews.text: Saree quality romba nalla, super color and finish.
Delivery was 4 days late, very frustrating experience.
LED bulbs working perfectly, good price for the quality.
Item vantha packaging mosam ah irundhuchu, box damaged.
Staff mikka friendly and helped me pick the right size.
Notebooks paper quality is average, not great not bad.
Worst experience — wrong item sent and no refund yet.
Rice quality super, will order again next month.
Price konjam adhigama irukku but service is fast and reliable.
Utensils looked nice in photo but real quality is poor.
Bohot badhiya service aur fast delivery hai! Highly recommended.
Saman bahut accha hai, pricing bhi reasonable hai.
